questionText:
Arrange the given steps of menstrual cycle in correct sequence.
(A) Menstruation
(B) Luteal phase
(C) Follicular phase
(D) Next cycle starts

options.explanation: Option A ((A), (B), (C), (D)) is inconsistent with canonical textbook criteria.

Option D ((C), (B), (D), (Α)) is inconsistent with canonical textbook criteria.

detailedSolution:
**Step-by-Step Breakdown:**
['(A) Menstruation marks the beginning of the menstrual flow lasting 3-5 days.', '(C) Follicular phase follows menstruation, characterized by primary follicle development and endometrial proliferation.', '(B) Luteal phase begins after ovulation as the ruptured follicle transforms into the corpus luteum.', '(D) Degeneration of the corpus luteum causes endometrial sloughing, initiating the next cycle.', 'The sequence is (A), (C), (B), (D).']

solution.quick: The menstrual cycle sequence is Menstruation (A) -> Follicular phase (C) -> Luteal phase (B) -> Next cycle starts (D): (A), (C), (B), (D).
solution.concept: The human female menstrual cycle consists of sequential phases: 1. Menstrual phase (days 1-5, breakdown of endometrium), 2. Follicular/proliferative phase (days 6-13, follicle growth stimulated by FSH/LH), 3. Luteal/secretory phase (days 15-28, corpus luteum secretes progesterone), and 4. Start of the next cycle if fertilization does not occur.
step_by_step: (A) Menstruation marks the beginning of the menstrual flow lasting 3-5 days.
(C) Follicular phase follows menstruation, characterized by primary follicle development and endometrial proliferation.
(B) Luteal phase begins after ovulation as the ruptured follicle transforms into the corpus luteum.
(D) Degeneration of the corpus luteum causes endometrial sloughing, initiating the next cycle.
The sequence is (A), (C), (B), (D).
detailed: (A) Menstruation marks the beginning of the menstrual flow lasting 3-5 days.
(C) Follicular phase follows menstruation, characterized by primary follicle development and endometrial proliferation.
(B) Luteal phase begins after ovulation as the ruptured follicle transforms into the corpus luteum.
(D) Degeneration of the corpus luteum causes endometrial sloughing, initiating the next cycle.
The sequence is (A), (C), (B), (D).
